title: Holi-Spatial 360: Generative Reconstruction from Sparse Panoramas for Spatial Rendering and Intelligence
title_zh: Holi-Spatial 360：基于稀疏全景的生成式重建，用于空间渲染与智能感知

paragraphs.en: Holi-Spatial 360 是一个生成式重建与数据策展框架，能够将稀疏的全景图像转换为多房间的三维环境。 Spatial intelligence requires scalable 3D environments that are both photorealistic and semantically grounded, yet existing indoor datasets are dominated by room-scale captures and costly LiDAR acquisition. Online real-estate platforms offer abundant panoramas of diverse multi-room homes, but sparse viewpoints and texture-poor regions make reconstruction severely under-constrained. We introduce Holi-Spatial 360, a generative reconstruction and data curation framework for converting these panoramas into annotated multi-room 3D environments. Because reconstruction quality bounds subsequent generation, our Correspondence-Guided Geometric Optimization converts feed-forward reconstruction priors into reliable cross-view constraints and builds a coherent 3D Gaussian Splatting representation as 3D spatial memory. Adapted single-image and video priors then restore appearance and complete continuous trajectories while preserving observed content. The reconstructed scenes support arbitrary RGB-D rendering and an automated curation pipeline that combines end-to-end 3D grounding with VLM-based verification. Holi360 contains over 1K multi-room 3DGS scenes, more than 100K instance annotations, and 2M spatial question-answer pairs. We also introduce the Holi360 benchmark to evaluate the spatial understanding of VLMs in real-world, multi-room indoor environments. Experiments demonstrate superior reconstruction and curation quality under sparse panoramic inputs, while fine-tuning VLMs on Holi360 substantially improves spatial reasoning capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: Holi-Spatial 360 是一个生成式重建与数据策展框架，能够将稀疏的全景图像转换为包含多个房间的三维环境。空间智能需要可扩展的三维环境，这些环境既需具备照片级真实感，也需具有语义基础，然而现有的室内数据集主要由房间尺度的采集数据和成本高昂的激光雷达数据构成。 在线房地产平台提供了大量多样化多居室住宅的全景图像，但稀疏的视角和纹理贫乏的区域使得重建过程严重缺乏约束。 我们提出了 Holi-Spatial 360，一个用于将这些全景图像转换为带标注的多居室三维环境的生成式重建与数据策展框架。 由于重建质量会影响后续的生成效果，我们的“对应关系引导的几何优化”方法将前向重建先验转化为可靠的跨视角约束，并构建出连贯的三维高斯泼溅表示作为空间记忆。 随后，适配的单图像和视频先验能够恢复外观并补全连续轨迹，同时保留已观察到的内容。 重建后的场景支持任意的 RGB-D 渲染，以及一个自动化的策展流程，该流程将端到端的三维语义绑定与基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的验证相结合。 Holi360 包含超过 1000 个多居室三维高斯泼溅场景、超过 10 万个实例标注以及 200 万个空间问答对。 我们还引入了 Holi360 基准数据集，用于评估视觉语言模型在真实世界多居室室内环境中的空间理解能力。 实验表明，在稀疏的全景输入条件下，该方法能够生成高质量的重建和策展结果；同时，在 Holi360 上微调视觉语言模型可显著提升其空间推理能力。
